'''''Integral Equations and Operator Theory''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published quarterly by [[Springer Science+Business Media]]. Established in 1978, it covers [[integral equations]] and [[operator theory]], as well as their applications to [[engineering]] and other [[mathematics|mathematical sciences]].<ref name="aims-scope">{{cite web |title=Integral Equations and Operator Theory: Aims and Scope |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/20/aims-and-scope |website=springer.com |access-date=August 22, 2026}}</ref> 

The founding editor-in-chief of the journal, in 1978, was [[Israel Gohberg]]. Its current editor-in-chief is [[Christiane Tretter]] ([[University of Bern]]).<ref name="editorial">{{cite web |title=Integral Equations and Operator Theory: Editorial Board |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/20/editorial-board |website=springer.com |access-date=August 22, 2026}}</ref>
